answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can bridge payments between services, with that stake slashed when its attestations prove false. New identities begin under an island quota: low transaction limits, no voting weight, and no access to shared rewards until they accumulate verified work. A haven of trusted reviewers audits disputed claims, so a Sybil attacker must fund, age, and risk many separate stakes instead of spawning free identities, making large-scale forgery expensive and slow.
